mapper.select: select s.item_id, sum(s.qty) as qty from inv_stock s left join lot_master lm on lm.lot_id = s.lot_id where s.plant_cd = #{plantCd} and s.item_id in #{id} and s.qty > 0 and (s.lot_id is null or lm.hold_yn = 'N') and group by s.item_id

select l.order_line_id, -sum(t.qty) as qty from inv_trx t join wms_ship_pick p on p.pick_id = t.src_id join wms_ship_line l on l.ship_line_id = p.ship_line_id where t.src_type = 'SHIP_PICK' and t.trx_type = 'SHIP' and l.order_line_id in #{id} group by l.order_line_id

select p.lot_id, s.ship_id, s.ship_no, s.plant_cd, s.cust_id, c.cust_cd, c.cust_nm, s.shipped_at, l.item_id, -sum(t.qty) as qty, max(t.unit_cd) as unit_cd, string_agg(distinct pl.pallet_no, E'\t') as pallet_nos, string_agg(distinct pl.sscc, E'\t') as ssccs from wms_ship_pick p join inv_trx t on t.comp_cd = p.comp_cd and t.src_type = 'SHIP_PICK' and t.src_id = p.pick_id and t.trx_type = 'SHIP' join wms_ship_line l on l.ship_line_id = p.ship_line_id join wms_ship s on s.ship_id = l.ship_id join mst_cust c on c.cust_id = s.cust_id left join wms_pallet pl on pl.pallet_id = p.pallet_id where p.lot_id in #{id} group by p.lot_id, s.ship_id, s.ship_no, s.plant_cd, s.cust_id, c.cust_cd, c.cust_nm, s.shipped_at, l.item_id having sum(t.qty) <> 0 order by p.lot_id, s.shipped_at, s.ship_id

select s.lot_id, s.plant_cd, s.node_id, wms_node_path(s.node_id) as path, a.loc_usage, s.stock_status, s.qty from inv_stock s left join wms_loc_attr a on a.node_id = s.node_id where s.lot_id in #{id} and s.qty > 0 order by s.lot_id, s.plant_cd, path
select s.plant_cd, s.stock_status, sum(s.qty) as qty from inv_stock s where s.lot_id = #{lotId} and s.qty <> 0 group by s.plant_cd, s.stock_status

select s.lot_id, lm.lot_no, s.item_id, sum(s.qty) as qc_qty from inv_stock s join lot_master lm on lm.lot_id = s.lot_id where s.plant_cd = #{plantCd} and s.stock_status = 'QC' and s.lot_id is not null and s.lot_id > #{afterLotId} group by s.lot_id, lm.lot_no, s.item_id having sum(s.qty) > 0 order by s.lot_id limit #{limit}
